features.description: Reject codex guesses and verify caller separation
acceptance_criteria: Re-audit GuessProvider, ProviderFromString, EnvVarForProvider, factory.New and envpolicy callers before edits; record mission spawn-recipe pins reaching the codex executor rather than the AI effect.

ProviderCodex sentinel covers codex* guesses and string parsing; no API-key variable is associated with it; direct and registry-fallback construction pin the actionable #903 error pointing to chatgpt/.
Motoko preflight checks subscription credentials and classifies the sentinel as subscription; mission executor routing and explicit provider: openai registry rows retain their behavior.
Existing provider-prefix fixtures and coordinator spawn-recipe regression tests pass.
features.notes: Pre-edit caller audit recorded. Sentinel refuses direct and fallback factory construction; CLI/eval regressions, subscription preflight, explicit OpenAI row and mission routing fixtures pass.

features.description: Bound interim client and prepare Phase 1 release
acceptance_criteria: Default HTTP deadline is 10 minutes, WithTimeout overrides it, and a continuously streaming httptest response terminates at the configured deadline; earlier context cancellation also works.
No parallel timeout flag or env variable is introduced; #1259 absorption is documented.
README describes subscription-first auth and the explicitly metered alternative; preserve the already-landed supersession banner rather than duplicating it.
A1–A5 and focused go test + make test-core pass; Phase 1 can ship independently before any Phase 2 code is merged.
Phase 1 STOP: commit M1-M2 locally with Refs #903, report, and stop; do not start D8 or M3 in the same run.
features.notes: 10-minute total deadline and WithTimeout implemented; continuous-stream kill and earlier cancellation fixtures pass. #1259 absorption documented. Core, fmt, lint (0 issues), architecture and file-size checks pass. STOP after local Refs #903 commit.

features.description: Measure motoko-chatgpt-gpt-6-1-sol tool use, write it up, then STOP/BLOCKED for the maintainer ruling
acceptance_criteria: Data source named and read: per-run eval result JSON for model motoko-chatgpt-gpt-6-1-sol under eval_results/ (agent_tool_calls, agent_transcript tool_call lines from native_tool_calls), plus ailang chains records naming the row; files/chains, dates and run count recorded (zero runs is a valid result).

Per run: tool-call count, tools used, harness tool loop (std/ai Step with tools) vs effectively single-turn; written to design_docs/planned/v0_52_6/m-codex-subscription-lane-d8-measurement.md. No code and no models.yml change.
Write-up states options (a) delegate-to-codex and (b) metered lane for the tool-loop arm and what the data implies, without choosing.
STOP / BLOCKED for the maintainer D8 ruling; the executor does not pick an arm.

features.description: Adapt the existing executor to the AI provider contract
acceptance_criteria: Generate uses the existing codex executor and its NDJSON parser with bounded time/turns, cancellation, and the read-only question tool set; no coordinator import from the adapter.
Strip codex: from pinned models; bare codex names reach the CLI unchanged and fail loudly there; prompt, final text, token/cache usage, finish reason and failures map correctly.
Step with harness tools returns CodeToolsNotSupported; tool-free Step delegates to Generate; images return CodeCapabilityNotSupported; no streaming interface is claimed.
Fake-executor fixtures cover success, failure, malformed or missing output, cancellation, model normalization and unsupported requests; no subprocess starts for rejected capabilities.

features.description: Enforce subscription auth, serialization and cost provenance
acceptance_criteria: Read-only credential validation moves to the platform layer, honors CODEX_HOME, and refuses missing, expired or API-key credentials with CodeAuthFailed; CLI owns refresh.
A process-wide mutex keyed by canonical auth path serializes validation plus execution; canceled queued calls exit without spawning and locks release after failure.

Subprocess environment excludes metered-key authority; subscription classification yields CostListPriceEquivalent with real tokens, and absent rates yield unknown provenance rather than fabricated spend.

Audit the codex/oauth job selection. In-process locking alone is insufficient for multiple processes or workers sharing one credential; record fleet serialization / isolated-credential work as a follow-up in the sprint report (not a pass condition).

features.description: Wire hosts and resolve motoko migration before replacement
acceptance_criteria: Inject a codex constructor without a core-to-platform import; both handler construction paths and eval harness wire it; unwired builds return a named registration error.
Repeat the factory.New grep including aliases and indirect callers; audit apiserver effect hosting and wire every supported host or document a deliberate fail-loud build.
Apply the recorded D8 ruling to models.yml; if the ruling is not recorded in the design doc, do not touch models.yml: STOP and report BLOCKED.
Preserve historical registry identity as appropriate and verify changed row lookup, auth-lane classification and external references; migration has no silent reroute.

features.description: Remove direct backend and validate Phase 2 release
acceptance_criteria: Only after the D8 ruling is recorded and M5 applied it: Remove direct-backend client and obsolete credential implementation after references migrate; retain ProviderChatGPT as a loud deprecation error naming codex: and retain historical CanonicalQuotaBucket folding.
No production path calls chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex; chatgpt/ deprecation, tool refusal and history rollup regressions pass.
Read ailang prompt before writing the example; ailang check validates examples/ai/codex_generate.ail; document required auth and single-turn contract plus both release migration notes.
Write the live-probe procedure (codex AI-effect probe with OPENAI_API_KEY absent; one run of the migrated motoko row). The probe is maintainer-run evidence attached later, not executor acceptance.
Focused tests, formatting, lint and architecture gates pass; fleet serialization is a report follow-up before shared-credential rollout, not a pass condition.
